LanguageData.Skylight_NoRoof: No roof above — open sky already lights this spot
LanguageData.Skylight_ThickRoof: Blocked by overhead mountain — no daylight gets through solid rock
LanguageData.Skylight_NeedsSupport: Must be within {0} tiles of a wall or pillar to hold up the roof
LanguageData.Skylights_DomeRadiusDesc: How far the soft light from dome and mountain-dome skylights spreads. Takes effect immediately.
LanguageData.Skylights_CustomRoofShadows: Custom roof shadows — crisp shadow line at roof edges
LanguageData.Skylights_CustomRoofShadowsDesc: Draws a hard, architectural shadow line where a roof meets open sky (a room's outer walls and skylight openings), instead of a diffuse glow. Turn off to revert to vanilla roof shading. Takes effect immediately.
LanguageData.Skylights_OffsetSpriteDesc: Nudges the installed skylight's sprite so it lines up with the offset roof-edge shadow. Purely cosmetic — the tile it lights is unchanged. Takes effect immediately.
